project_title: Pousada Management System (Sistema de Gestão de Pousada)
aesthetic_summary: A warm, hospitality-first aesthetic inspired by Brazilian coastal and mountain inns (Búzios, Paraty, Gramado, Trancoso). Combines warm terracotta, sand beige, deep palm green, and rich espresso with a clean, high-density tactical admin dashboard. Avoids generic blue/purple SaaS gradients.

responsive.layout: Mobile viewport prioritized (375px-430px). Navigation transforms into a sleek bottom sheet or slide-out menu. Calendar switches seamlessly between full monthly matrix on desktop to compact single-row weekly view or vertical agenda view on mobile screens. Multi-column financial metrics wrap into single vertical cards. Tap targets are at least 44x44px with 16px min form inputs to avoid automatic iOS browser zoom.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling using rems and clamp(). Mobile main headings text-3xl to text-4xl, desktop text-5xl. Subtitles scale down cleanly.
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root. Calendar grids employ inner scrolling with shadow indicators for swipeability.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for buttons, status toggles, calendar date cells, and mobile table row actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React .js files in src/ (do NOT use TypeScript syntax in .js files).
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status badges (e.g. data-testid='reservation-status-badge', data-testid='btn-create-reservation').
Never use generic blue/purple SaaS templates. Follow the warm Terracotta (#C85A32) & Palm Green (#2D5A43) palette on Sand background (#FAF7F2).
Ensure dark mode support via Tailwind dark: classes with deep espresso slate background (#12100E).
Integrate Lucide React icons (@lucide-react or lucide-react) for clear UI indicators.
Use sonner for toast feedback (e.g. 'Chave PIX copiada!', 'Reserva salva com sucesso!', 'iCal sincronizado').
Provide clear PT-BR strings for all Brazilian hospitality terms (FNRH, Check-in, Check-out, Hóspede, Diária, PIX, iCal, Calção, Receita, Despesa).
